trap-superlative.notes: PROPOSED: 'is a candidate physical realization' / 'would be the order-parameter discontinuity', matching the block's own Generalisation (conditional) register. THE UNDERLYING ALGEBRA IS CORRECT and I verified it by hand: t_1 = t_2 iff 2(q + 1/q) = (q - 1/q)(q + 1/q) iff q - 1/q = 2 (dividing by q + 1/q > 0) iff q^2 - 2q - 1 = 0 iff q = 1 + sqrt2 = 2.4142136 = delta_silver; the general statement also checks, since the Hecke relation sigma^2 = (q - 1/q) sigma + 1 gives sigma^2 = n sigma + 1 exactly when q - 1/q = n, and q - 1/q = n iff q = (n + sqrt(n^2+4))/2 = delta_n; phi^2 = 2.6180340 and 1/phi^2 = 0.3819660 are bar-mirrors as stated; and the degenerate-face argument is right.
